fixes.explanation: Right, friend, and God keeps it all on the building side. He says He has filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God, "…with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship…" Then comes the job list: artistic works in gold, silver and bronze, cutting gemstones for settings, and carving wood (Exodus 31:4–5). Gold, gems and wood, no battle plans anywhere. I'd call that a man you'd trust with a cookie box AND a lampstand.
